about_the_game:
Oh no! Pachiko, the mascot of the Shige Channel, is up to mischief again!

You've found yourself trapped in a mysterious looping space.
Observe your surroundings carefully. If there’s nothing unusual, proceed toward the exit (blue sign).
If you sense anything strange, head toward the interior of the building (orange sign).

Choosing the correct path appears to move time forward.
Hang in there until 8 o’clock...

“８゜子 / Pachiko” is a game inspired by “Exit 8,” where you search for strange anomalies in a looping environment.

Estimated Playtime

  • Approximately 30 to 60 minutes

Controls

  • Move: WASD + Mouse

  • Run: Hold Shift

  • Menu: ESC / E

Game System

  • The same anomaly will not appear again until all other anomalies have been discovered.

Video Streaming Guidelines

  • You are free to upload or stream gameplay videos without prior permission, whether as an individual or organization.

  • Monetization is allowed only when using official monetization features provided by video sharing platforms.

  • Including the game’s title in the video thumbnail or stream title, and linking to the Steam store page in the description, would be greatly appreciated.

  • We are not responsible for any damages or issues arising from gameplay videos or livestreams of this game.

These guidelines are subject to change without notice.
